sentences.text: 3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that at the time of incident prosecutrix was below 15 years of age.
On 27.09.2023, when the prosecutrix was returning home after nature's call, the applicant came there and committed rape upon her.
Matter was reported on 29.09.2023 by the prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that he has not committed the offence and has falsely been implicated in the case.

It is submitted that after dismissal of first application of the applicant, the prosecutrix (PW-1), her father (PW-2), mother (PW-3) and brother have been examined before the trial Court, but they had completely turned hostile and not supported the case of prosecution.
Prosecutrix and her parents have also submitted that prosecutrix is aged around 19 years, therefore, it is clear that the applicant has not committed the offence.
5. It is also submitted that he is in custody since 03.10.2023.
Conclusion of trial will take considerable long time for its disposal.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
6. On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State has opposed the prayer and prayed for rejection of the application.

7. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the changed circumstances, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail hence, the application is allowed.

8. It is directed that applicant - Vijay shall be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during pendency of the trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
9. This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
10. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
